apps.subtitle: iOS 27 MobileGestalt 编辑器
apps.localizedDescription: GestaltX，开源 MobileGestalt 编辑工具。支持地区代码、设备预设、备份与本机写入。本机 MobileGestalt 访问需要 iOS 27；IPA 部署目标为 26.0。签名时主应用与分享扩展须使用同一个 App Group。

versions.localizedDescription:
GestaltX 1.0.3
• 新增分享导入：在“文件”或其他 App 中分享 plist 到 GestaltX，核验后弹窗确认导入。
• 加强设备归属校验，拒绝不匹配或无法核验的文件；本机导出的文件可携带设备校验凭证。
• 优化 MG 控制，支持新增、修改、重命名和删除键值。
• 支持恢复已核验的本机 plist，恢复前自动备份，完成后请重启设备。

重签时请保留分享扩展，并为主应用和扩展配置同一个 App Group。

GestaltX 1.0.3
• Added share import: share a plist to GestaltX from Files or another app, then confirm the import after verification.
• Strengthened device ownership checks. Mismatched or unverifiable files are rejected; exports can include a device-bound verification proof.
• Improved MG Control with support for adding, editing, renaming, and deleting keys and values.
• Added restoration of verified device plists, with an automatic backup before restoring. Restart your device afterward.

When re-signing, keep the share extension and configure the same App Group for both the app and extension.
